The copied functions and profiles retain their common translations and reflections, since the same groups and representatives are used in each copy. For the terminal grouping there is just one group in each copy; no factor 1/8 is needed before normalization, and the common allowance is Q j λi(H, l)Wj. Its remainder bound is 4 divided by this allowance, exactly the input to the terminal step above. Finally, the paid even-moment bound can be seen directly from its lattice layout.
